genius.notes: JPYSC is a Japanese trust-issued electronic payment instrument. The FSA distinguishes the trust-bank issuance route, and the opened token disclosures do not establish the statutory bank-deposit exclusion. SBI VC Trade discloses buy/sell at 1 JPY per JPYSC, with initial distribution limited to customer accounts and external-wallet withdrawals disabled. Overseas/public-chain use remains prospective. The September 7 reserve release is issuer self-reporting; no dated monthly independent attestation was found. Japanese trust-bank authorization does not establish GENIUS PPSI approval or a registered foreign exception. No named U.S. approval, official GENIUS application or concrete token-specific filing intention was located. Treasury's August 17 proposal gives January 18, 2027 as the expected effectiveness date, subject to the statutory final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC interim final rule is procedural. not-yet-restricted describes only GENIUS's phased DASP restriction, not general U.S. legality or authorization. The broad DASP prohibition starts July 18, 2028; the foreign lawful-order condition starts when the Act becomes effective.
